regulatory_body: Central Water Commission, Ministry of Jal Shakti
standard: Guidelines for Preparation of Emergency Action Plans for Dams

H1_LOW.impact: Wading possible for adults; passenger vehicles can navigate with caution

H2_MEDIUM.impact: Vehicles swept away; pedestrian evacuation hazardous; unreinforced masonry stable

H3_HIGH.impact: Severe structural damage to masonry; complete road washout; immediate evacuation imperative

H4_EXTREME.impact: Total structural destruction; catastrophic erosion; complete zone quarantine
